query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `client_account_setup` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `client_id` int NOT NULL,
  `fb_email` varchar(320),
  `fb_password` text,
  `fb_page_id` varchar(64),
  `fb_page_name` varchar(255),
  `fb_access_token` text,
  `ig_username` varchar(100),
  `ig_password` text,
  `linkedin_email` varchar(320),
  `linkedin_password` text,
  `linkedin_page_url` varchar(500),
  `tiktok_username` varchar(100),
  `tiktok_password` text,
  `youtube_email` varchar(320),
  `youtube_password` text,
  `youtube_channel_url` varchar(500),
  `twitter_username` varchar(100),
  `twitter_password` text,
  `website_url` varchar(500),
  `website_platform` varchar(50),
  `website_admin_url` varchar(500),
  `website_admin_email` varchar(320),
  `website_admin_password` text,
  `ftp_host` varchar(255),
  `ftp_username` varchar(255),
  `ftp_password` text,
  `hosting_provider` varchar(100),
  `hosting_email` varchar(320),
  `hosting_password` text,
  `domain_registrar` varchar(100),
  `domain_email` varchar(320),
  `domain_password` text,
  `meta_ad_account_id` varchar(100),
  `meta_ad_email` varchar(320),
  `meta_ad_password` text,
  `meta_bm_id` varchar(100),
  `google_ads_customer_id` varchar(50),
  `google_ads_email` varchar(320),
  `google_ads_password` text,
  `google_analytics_id` varchar(50),
  `google_search_console_access` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `tiktok_ads_account_id` varchar(100),
  `tiktok_ads_email` varchar(320),
  `tiktok_ads_password` text,
  `wants_new_website` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `website_goal` varchar(50),
  `website_style` varchar(50),
  `website_pages` text,
  `website_features` text,
  `website_color_primary` varchar(20),
  `website_color_secondary` varchar(20),
  `website_examples` text,
  `website_additional_notes` text,
  `setup_completed_at` timestamp NULL,
  `last_updated_section` varchar(50),
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `client_account_setup_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
